title: Matched Round471 higher-update PPO replay comparison
status: Round471 not promoted · Round430 remains validated
method: Round471 replayed the audited 20,000-game Round468 corpus from the Round430 initialization, changing only learning rate and update passes. Evaluation used the same 512 held-out team-pair clusters and Round402 team selectors on both sides, with two side-swapped outcomes per cluster. Paired confidence intervals use 20,000 cluster bootstrap resamples; Showdown battle RNG is not directly controllable.

training.Round471: Learning rate 1e-4 (doubled) and 8 PPO passes; all 2,616 optimizer steps completed with KL guard enabled.
training.data: Reused 20,000 audited games / 167,383 decision transitions; no new rollout simulation.
training.runtime: Sample preparation 107.2 s; CUDA PPO optimization 110.0 s, 23.8 optimizer steps/s.

interpretation: All paired intervals include zero and all point estimates are slightly negative. The larger PPO update did not establish a strength gain; keep Round430 as the default. The win-probability head remains auxiliary and does not select moves.
